t: What Hardware Interface Database Is All About

description: Hardware interfaces connect: PCIe (expansion: gen4/5/6 doubling bandwidth), USB (USB4/Thunderbolt: 40Gbps+), NVMe (storage protocol), DDR (memory slots), SATA (legacy storage), HDMI/DisplayPort (video).
